title: Projecting a Borrow Guard
goal: Return a Ref guard targeting a string field using `Ref::map`.
hints: `Ref::map` expects a shared Ref<T> guard, not a RefMut<T> or a Result.
The return type is Ref<str>, so the mapping closure must produce a string slice &str.
explanation: `Ref::map` transforms a `Ref<Data>` into a `Ref<str>` by consuming the original guard and storing a reference to `&d.value[..]`. Using `borrow_mut()` produces a `RefMut` which cannot be passed to `Ref::map` (error `E0308`). Returning `&d.value` yields a `Ref<String>` instead of `Ref<str>`, which causes a type mismatch error `E0308`.
